description.en: Neo-brutalism: thick black outlines, hard offset shadows and a loud accent on a dotted page; the button presses in when you hover it. Pick a bright accent, the text on it stays black. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, the selected tab, checkboxes and the focus shadow. Use a bright color: the text on it is black.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 45 100% 96%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --popover: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --muted: 45 60% 92%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 15%;
  --accent: 45 60% 92%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 0%;
  --border: 0 0% 0%;
  --input: 0 0% 0%;
  --ring: 0 0% 0%;
  font-family: 'Space Grotesk', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background-color: #fff3d6;
  background-image: radial-gradient(#000000 1.2px, transparent 1.3px);
  background-size: 22px 22px;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 440px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 3px solid #000000;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 10px 10px 0 #000000;
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #000000;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  gap: 8px;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border: 2px solid #000000;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  color: #000000;
  font-weight: 700;
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000000 !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: {{accentColor}} !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 46px;
  border: 2.5px solid #000000;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #000000;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000000;
  transition: transform 0.08s, box-shadow 0.08s;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  outline: none;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 {{accentColor}}, 6px 6px 0 2.5px #000000;
  transform: translate(-2px, -2px);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 2.5px solid #000000;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #000000;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #000000;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-thickness: 3px;
  text-decoration-color: {{accentColor}};
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 52px;
  border: 2.5px solid #000000;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #000000;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #000000;
  transition: transform 0.08s, box-shadow 0.08s;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000000;
  transform: translate(3px, 3px);
}
#footer {
  color: #000000;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
